effects.text: Move each chosen creature's token to any point within the radius; not into an environmentally dangerous place (such as 100 feet up). An unwilling creature may make a Will save to avoid it.

system.description:
Upon casting this spell, you may instantly teleport any creature from one location to another within the radius of the spell. You cannot transport a creature into an environmentally dangerous situation (such as 100 foot into the air). An unwilling target may make a Will save to avoid the effect.

Not automated: where each creature goes is the caster's choice on the map; move the tokens, and roll an unwilling creature's Will save, by hand.
